title: The localizing closure
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside it, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$. Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring annihilated by a power of $\ell$. Let $X$ be a scheme, and let $\Lambda$ be one of $A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, regarded as a condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]: $A$ has the discrete topology, and the other rings have the topologies induced by the $\ell$-adic absolute value on $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Write $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ for its pulled-back sheaf of rings [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and put
$$
\mathcal T=D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\Lambda):=D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X}),
$$
where $\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$ is the category of module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and $D$ denotes the unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\mathcal S=\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$ be the bounded constructible complexes of finite Tor amplitude defined in [sk-def-sfb-constructible].

The localizing closure $\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda))$ is the full subcategory of $\mathcal T$ on the objects belonging to every full replete triangulated subcategory [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory] that contains $\mathcal S$ and is closed under all small coproducts in $\mathcal T$. Here replete means closed under isomorphisms, and small is relative to the fixed indexing universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Thus this is the smallest such subcategory; the coproducts are those of the ambient unbounded module-object derived category. In particular, no derived-completeness condition is imposed in taking this closure.
